stem: Over one week, a zone shows progressively faster dryback and lower measured emitter output while temperature, crop stage, and neighboring zones remain stable. What is the best technician response?
choices: Document the linked trend and request investigation of the zone-specific delivery system before a crop-wide schedule change
Increase all room irrigation without checking the zone
Delete the emitter data because it conflicts with the schedule
rationale: The localized delivery trend aligns with the changing dryback pattern and supports targeted investigation rather than a room-wide correction.
